Radio Exterior España FAQ

What frequency is Radio Exterior España on?
In the B-26 season Radio Exterior España is scheduled on 8 shortwave frequencies, including 9690, 11965, 12030, 15390, 15500, 15520 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9690 kHz (7 pm – 10 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9690 kHz (4 pm – 12 am UTC+1).

What time is Radio Exterior España on shortwave?
Radio Exterior España is scheduled in 20 UTC time windows this season, from 00:00–02:00 UTC through 23:30–24h UTC. No English broadcasts are listed this season. All times are UTC; subtract your UTC offset for local time.

Can I hear Radio Exterior España in the USA?
Yes. Radio Exterior España is beamed at North America this season on 9690, 15500 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 9690 kHz (7 pm – 10 pm Eastern).

Does Radio Exterior España broadcast in English on shortwave?
Not this season. Radio Exterior España is scheduled in Spanish, Mandarin, Russian.

Is Radio Exterior España on the air right now?
As of Tuesday, November 10, 2026, 15:56 UTC, Radio Exterior España is scheduled to be broadcasting on 9690 kHz to North America. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
